owner_requirement.pairing: Reciprocal SKU pair configured once and visible from both sides
owner_requirement.target: Any active target SKU; different brand, color or size is allowed
owner_requirement.display: Real-time source and target stock plus moving-average value before posting
owner_requirement.reverse_business_flow: A later mistaken swap-back is a new lawful Ganti Merek transaction, not hidden automatic batch matching

exact_conflict.readme_statement: One request allocates FIFO by produced_at,id and explicitly says that no new FG average is created.
exact_conflict.sql_statement: cp7_sku_conversion.preview_v1 selects eligible source lots ordered by l.produced_at,l.id and sums each lot quantity multiplied by that lot's current hpp_per_pcs.
exact_conflict.ui_statement: The screen says that source stock is selected in sequence and shows only aggregate source value, not source/target moving averages.
exact_conflict.conclusion: Current37 may qualify its frozen FIFO/lot implementation, but that result cannot close the owner's later moving-average requirement.

required_correction_after_active_integra.physical_lineage: Deterministic lot allocation may remain solely to preserve exact stock lineage and reversibility; lot order must not choose the accounting valuation.
required_correction_after_active_integra.source_average: Capture the weighted moving-average HPP of eligible source FG at the exact location, quality and physical time under the existing FG/HPP lock.
required_correction_after_active_integra.conversion_value: Transferred inventory value equals quantity multiplied by the captured source moving average, rounded through one declared cent-conservation rule.
required_correction_after_active_integra.target_average: Preview and posting show and preserve target quantity, target value and target moving average before and after the conversion.
required_correction_after_active_integra.source_after: Preview and posting show source quantity, source value and source moving average before and after; no negative stock or negative value.
required_correction_after_active_integra.journals: Inventory reclassification remains balanced; no sales revenue, COGS, cash, receivable or payable entry is created.
required_correction_after_active_integra.sales_COGS: Later sales consume the authoritative post-conversion target valuation, not the old FIFO lot price.
required_correction_after_active_integra.swap_back: A manual later reverse-direction conversion uses the then-current moving averages and a new request identity; exact original restoration is only expected when no intervening mix changes the averages.
required_correction_after_active_integra.permissions_and_idempotency: Retain current rights checks after waits, closed payloads, stale preview refusal, exact replay and changed-intent refusal.

required_future_evidence_not_run_here: Two source lots with different HPP prove valuation uses weighted source average rather than oldest lot HPP
Existing target stock with a different average proves exact target average before and after
One- and two-piece cross-brand conversions conserve total FG value and journal balance
Different color and size targets remain allowed while reciprocal pair is only a suggestion
Concurrent sale/reservation and two-tab conversion cannot overspend source quantity or stale average
Manual swap-back with no intervening movement restores the expected source value; with intervening stock it uses the lawful then-current average
Atomic reversal restores stock, value, average, journal and history
Desktop and 390px UI display both stock and moving averages
